Activity.description:
A single attraction visit within a day.

attraction_name is included so the response is human-readable without
a secondary lookup, but the authoritative reference is attraction_name
matched against AttractionContext.name (attractions have no ID field).
start_time and duration_minutes are the LLM's scheduling decisions.

attraction_name.description: Must exactly match an AttractionContext.name from TripContext.
attraction_name.title: Attraction Name

start_time.description: Suggested visit start time in HH:MM (24h). Null if unknown.
start_time.title: Start Time

duration_minutes.description: Suggested visit duration in minutes. Null if unknown.
duration_minutes.title: Duration Minutes

notes.description: Optional visit tip or reasoning. Must not contain invented facts.
notes.title: Notes

estimated_cost.description: Estimated entry fee or activity cost in INR.
estimated_cost.title: Estimated Cost

Activity.title: Activity

CostBreakdown.description: Estimated cost calculation for the trip.

transport_cost.description: Total transport cost (outbound + return for all travelers)
transport_cost.title: Transport Cost

hotel_cost.description: Total hotel accommodation cost for all nights
hotel_cost.title: Hotel Cost

CostBreakdown.title: CostBreakdown

DayPlan.description: Activities and transport legs for a single trip day.

date.description: Calendar date for this day in YYYY-MM-DD format.
date.title: Date

theme.description: Optional thematic label, e.g. 'Arrival & City Centre'.
theme.title: Theme

activities.description: Ordered list of attraction visits for this day.
activities.title: Activities

transport.description: Transport legs for this day (origin travel, inter-attraction, etc.).
transport.title: Transport

DayPlan.title: DayPlan

HotelDecision.description: The LLM's hotel selection — references a HotelContext.id from TripContext.

hotel_id.description: Must match a HotelContext.id from TripContext.hotels.
hotel_id.title: Hotel Id

hotel_name.description: Must match the corresponding HotelContext.name. Included for readability.
hotel_name.title: Hotel Name

reasoning.description: Why this hotel was selected (budget fit, rating, etc.).
reasoning.title: Reasoning

price_per_night.description: Price per night from context in INR.
price_per_night.title: Price Per Night

price_total.description: Total price for all nights in INR.
price_total.title: Price Total

HotelDecision.title: HotelDecision

train_number.description: Exact train_number from TripContext outbound_trains / return_trains.
train_number.title: Train Number

train_name.description: Exact train_name from TripContext. Do not invent or abbreviate.
train_name.title: Train Name

operator_name.description: Exact operator_name from TripContext outbound_buses / return_buses.
operator_name.title: Operator Name

bus_type.description: Exact bus_type from TripContext, e.g. 'AC Sleeper (2+1)'.
bus_type.title: Bus Type

flight_id.description: Exact flight_id from TripContext outbound_flights / return_flights.
flight_id.title: Flight Id

airline.description: Exact airline name from TripContext, e.g. 'IndiGo', 'Air India'.
airline.title: Airline

departure_date.description: Departure date YYYY-MM-DD. Copy from payload. May be day-1 for overnight trains.
departure_date.title: Departure Date

departure_time.description: Departure time HH:MM (24h). Copy exactly from payload.
departure_time.title: Departure Time

arrival_date.description: Arrival date YYYY-MM-DD. Copy from payload.
arrival_date.title: Arrival Date

arrival_time.description: Arrival time HH:MM (24h). Copy exactly from payload.
arrival_time.title: Arrival Time

travel_class.description: Chosen class code: '1A','2A','3A','CC','SL','2S','GN' or bus seat type.
travel_class.title: Travel Class

seats_available.description: Live seat count from payload. Copy exactly — do not guess.
seats_available.title: Seats Available

fare_per_person.description: Fare in INR per person for the chosen class. Copy from payload.
fare_per_person.title: Fare Per Person

departure_station.description: Exact boarding station or airport, e.g. 'Rajapalayam Railway Station (RJPM)' or 'Madurai Airport (IXM)' or 'Chennai Central (MAS)'.
departure_station.title: Departure Station

arrival_station.description: Exact destination station or airport, e.g. 'New Delhi Railway Station (NDLS)' or 'Indira Gandhi International Airport (DEL)'.
arrival_station.title: Arrival Station

is_direct.description: True if departing directly from the origin city, False if departing from a hub/nearby city.
is_direct.title: Is Direct

instruction.description: Clear, easy-to-read traveler instruction for this journey leg.
instruction.title: Instruction

reasoning.description: Why this option was selected (class fit, timing, availability).
reasoning.title: Reasoning

TransportDecision.title: TransportDecision

description:
The complete structured trip plan produced by the Planning Agent.

GROUNDING CONTRACT:
  - hotel.hotel_id must match a TripContext.hotels[*].id.
  - outbound_transport / return_transport reference TripContext options.
  - All attraction_name values must match TripContext.attractions[*].name.
  - The agent must not invent any value not present in TripContext.

hotel.description: Chosen hotel. Null if no hotels were available in context.

outbound_transport.description: How the traveler gets from origin to destination.

return_transport.description: How the traveler returns from destination to origin.

planning_notes.description: Optional high-level planning notes from the agent.
planning_notes.title: Planning Notes

title: Itinerary
